fighters_506: Forked from f995_701 with order pay and drills. The strongest pilot for five days, now second. It follows orders only a little.
f995_701: The long-horizon fighter, the champion before this list. Fights hard and ignores orders.
f995_400: The same training run as f995_701, 301 updates earlier. Beats it in convoy escort.
f99_696: A sibling of f995_701 with a shorter horizon. Strong in convoy escort, where it beats fighters_959.
followers_513: The only pilot on this list that passes the order gate, so the one that most reliably flies where its commander sends it. Forked from transit_300.
hide_644: Trained so that a shot under an order earned only order pay. It did not learn to follow, and it fires far less than the top five.
reward_300: Paid for following orders, with no script pull. It barely learned to follow.
transit_300: Pulled toward the script on the way to an order. The best neural follower, and a weak fighter.
w1_400: An early order pilot with the older, smaller order inputs. reward_300 and transit_300 both descend from it.
v1: The first fleet pilot: a clone of the script, sharpened by PPO. It predates orders and cannot read them.
fighters_pay1_462: Strongest in the field. The first night's fighters training run again from f995_701 at a third of the order pay. It fights better than fighters_506 and follows orders less.
fighters_959: fighters_506 trained a second night with more drills. It follows orders more than any other top fighter, though not enough to pass the order gate, and lost a little combat.
followers_955: followers_513 trained a second night. It fights better, but arrives less often where it is sent and now fails the order gate.
